---
title: "Gharor-e-Aal-e-Ibba Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Muhib"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Gharor-e-Aal-e-Ibba Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.
Ana-e-Rab-e-Aula Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.

1
Hasan Ki Zaat Jo Aman-o-Amaan Ki Khaliq Hai.
Shahdton Ke Khuda Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.
Buredah Sar Ne Tilawat Jo Ki Tu Raaz Khula.
Daleel-e-Zaat-e-Khuda Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.

2
Yeh Tool-e-Sajdah-e-Khatam-e-Rasul Se Zahir Hai.
Makeen-e-Arsh-e-Aula Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.
Ali Tu Uqdah-e-Kusha Hain Tamam Aalam Ke.
Nabi Ke Uqdah Kusha Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.

3
Pukara Hur Yeh Ke Janat Hai Naqsh-e-Paye-e-Hussain.
Shafi-e-Rooz-e-Jaza Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.
 Muhib Hussain Ka Gham Hai Har Aik Gham Ka Elaj.
Har Aik Gham Ki Dawa Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain.

from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/gharor-e-aal-e-ibba-ko-hussain-kehtay-hain-tajpoints-fcce658fe60bb0a84411.md\")
_, metadata, body = path.read_text().split(\"---\", 2)
metadata = metadata.replace('title: \"Gharor-e-Aal-e-Ibba Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain\"', 'title: \"غرورِ آلِ عبا کو حسین کہتے ہیں\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Gharor-e-Aal-e-Ibba Ko Hussain Kehtay Hain\"').replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]\\n', '')
roman = [line.strip().removesuffix(\".\") for line in body.strip().splitlines()]
roman = [line[:1] + line[1:].lower() if line else \"\" for line in roman]
names = {\"aal-e-ibba\": \"Aal-e-Ibba\", \"hussain\": \"Hussain\", \"rab-e-aula\": \"Rab-e-Aula\", \"khuda\": \"Khuda\", \"khatam-e-rasul\": \"Khatam-e-Rasul\", \"arsh-e-aula\": \"Arsh-e-Aula\", \"nabi\": \"Nabi\", \"hur\": \"Hur\"}
import re
roman = [re.sub(r\"[A-Za-z]+(?:-[A-Za-z]+)*\", lambda match: names.get(match[0].lower(), match[0]), line) for line in roman]
# Capitalize proper names within compounds and preserve the original phonetic reading.
roman = [line.replace(\"Gharor-e-aal-e-ibba\", \"Gharor-e-Aal-e-Ibba\").replace(\"Ana-e-rab-e-aula\", \"Ana-e-Rab-e-Aula\").replace(\"Daleel-e-zaat-e-khuda\", \"Daleel-e-zaat-e-Khuda\").replace(\"tool-e-sajdah-e-khatam-e-rasul\", \"tool-e-sajdah-e-Khatam-e-Rasul\").replace(\"Makeen-e-arsh-e-aula\", \"Makeen-e-Arsh-e-Aula\").replace(\"naqsh-e-paye-e-hussain\", \"naqsh-e-paye-e-Hussain\") for line in roman]
source = \"\"\"غرورِ آلِ عبا کو حسین کہتے ہیں
انائے ربِ اعلیٰ کو حسین کہتے ہیں

۱
حسن کی ذات جو امن و اماں کی خالق ہے
شہادتوں کے خدا کو حسین کہتے ہیں
بریدہ سر نے تلاوت جو کی تو راز کھلا
دلیلِ ذاتِ خدا کو حسین کہتے ہیں

۲
یہ طولِ سجدۂ خاتمِ رسول سے ظاہر ہے
مکینِ عرشِ اعلیٰ کو حسین کہتے ہیں
علی تو عقدہ کشا ہیں تمام عالم کے
نبی کے عقدہ کشا کو حسین کہتے ہیں

۳
پکارا حر یہ کہ جنت ہے نقشِ پائے حسین
شفیعِ روزِ جزا کو حسین کہتے ہیں
محب حسین کا غم ہے ہر ایک غم کا علاج
ہر ایک غم کی دوا کو حسین کہتے ہیں\"\"\"
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in \"\\n\".join(roman).split(\"\\n\\n\")] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in source.split(\"\\n\\n\")] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
assert \"\\n\".join(roman).casefold() == \"\\n\".join(line.strip().removesuffix(\".\") for line in body.strip().splitlines()).casefold()
path.write_text(\"---\" + metadata + \"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(\"  \" + line if line else \"\" for line in roman) + \"\\n---\\n\\n\" + source + \"\\n\")
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the opening and three numbered stanzas align in both versions. Updated the title and text direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman forms “Ibba,” “Ana,” and “Shahdton” as عبا، انا، and شہادتوں, respectively.
